meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing is the final human-required handoff because the maintainer raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成版本号递增、构建校验、git 标签与发布说明生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发版都要手动改版本号、打标签、写发布说明。
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps, build checks, git tags, and changelog generation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if every release means manually editing versions, tagging, and writing release notes.

howto.what: 你让它发新版时,Claude 会判断该升 PATCH、MINOR 还是 MAJOR,统一八个清单文件的版本号,再构建、提交、打标签、推送、建 GitHub release 并重生成 CHANGELOG。npm publish 由人执行。
howto.when: 当你想给插件发新版本、升级版本号或做一次发布时触发。开始前需要先写好发布说明(release notes),再让它执行。

say.text: 把版本升到 1.2.3,走完整发布流程
say.note: 它会改清单文件、构建、提交、打标签并建 release

say.text: 这次是修 bug,按 PATCH 升版本并发布
say.note: 按补丁级别升版本,npm publish 仍由你手动执行

say.text: 核对八个清单文件的版本号是否都改成新版
say.note: 用 git grep 检查新版本与旧版本残留

howto.what_en: On a release, Claude picks PATCH/MINOR/MAJOR, updates the version in eight manifest files, then builds, commits, tags, pushes, creates the GitHub release and regenerates CHANGELOG. The final npm publish is left to a human.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to release a new version of the plugin or bump its version number. Write the release notes first, then run it.

say_en.text: Bump the version to 1.2.3 and run the full release flow
say_en.note: It updates manifests, builds, commits, and tags the release

say_en.text: This release is a bug fix — bump it as PATCH
say_en.note: Bumps the patch version; you still run npm publish yourself

say_en.text: Check that all eight manifests show the new version
say_en.note: Uses git grep to confirm the new version and old leftovers
